chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about the believer visiting his family, and he said:

"Yes." He said: "How often?" He said: "According to the measure of their virtues. Among them is one who visits every day, among them is one who visits every two days, and among them is one who visits every three days."
He said: Then I understood from the course of his speech that he was saying: "The least of them is once a week."

So he said to him: "At what time?" He said: "At the sun's decline, or shortly before that. Then Allah sends with him an angel who shows him what pleases him and conceals from him what he dislikes, so he sees joy and returns with comfort of eye."

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believing person, here referring to the deceased believer
key_terms.زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ: the decline of the sun, meaning midday
key_terms.فَضَائِلِهِمْ: their virtues or excellences, which determine the frequency of visitation
key_terms.قُرَّةِ عَيْنٍ: comfort and delight of the eye, meaning deep contentment
key_terms.مَلَكًا: an angel sent by Allah with the believer
key_terms.يَزُورُ: visits, meaning returns to see his family

ai.seo_question: Do believers visit their families after death, and how often do they do so?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the believer visits his family after death, and that the frequency of this visitation differs according to the degree of his virtues. It also specifies a time for this visitation and describes divine mercy, in that Allah sends an angel to show the believer what brings joy and to conceal what would cause distress.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.542 - Ishaq ibn Ammar asked Abu Al-Hasan al-Awwal, Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about whether a believer visits their family (after death).
Imam (as) replied: "Yes."

He (Ishaq) asked: ‘How often?’
The Imam said: "It depends on their level of virtue; some visit every day, some every two days, and some every three days."
He then noted, "The least frequent among them visit once a week."

He (Ishaq) then asked Him: "At what time?"
Imam (as) replied: "At the time of the sun's decline (midday) or just before that. Allah (swt) sends with them an angel who shows them what pleases them and conceals from them what they dislike, so they see joy and return to a state of contentment”.
